# TTS Renovation

> TTS Renovation is a small Swiss team offering home renovation, plumbing and tiling across Switzerland, with a 24/7 emergency plumbing service. Founded in 2020. Free on-site visits, fixed itemised quotes and a two-year workmanship guarantee. Service in English, German and French.

## Services

- [Home renovation](https://tts-renovation.ch/renovation): kitchen and bathroom remodels, complete interior renovations, structural updates and modern finishes.
- [Plumbing](https://tts-renovation.ch/plumbing): repairs and installations, water and drainage systems, and 24/7 emergency call-outs for burst pipes, leaks and blocked drains.
- [Tiling](https://tts-renovation.ch/tiles): installation of ceramic, porcelain and natural stone tiles for walls and floors.

## Key facts

- Service area: Switzerland
- Languages: English, German (Deutsch), French (Français)
- Founded: 2020 (6+ years in business)
- Track record: 180+ renovations, bathrooms and kitchens delivered
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00-17:00
- Emergency plumbing: 24/7, every day of the year
- Email replies: within 1-2 working days

## How we work

1. Free on-site visit: we come by, measure and listen. No fee, no obligation.
2. Fixed, itemised quote: what, how long and how much. The quoted price is the price paid.
3. End-to-end execution: clean site, respectful working hours, weekly progress updates with photos.
4. Two-year workmanship guarantee: if anything shifts, squeaks or leaks, we are back within 48 hours.
